decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The erection of a single storey side and rear extension and replacement of the existing ground floor side window with an enlarged window to the dwelling, as shown on drawing numbers A384/M1A, A384/M2B, A384/101 and A384/102, received 23 May 2006, is satisfactory as the development would appear secondary to the original house and would maintain the amenity of adjoining neighbours, and is considered to preserve and enhance the character and appearance of the Chiswick House Conservation Area. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, ENV-B.2.2 Conservation Areas and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations and Supplementary Planning Guidance.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of single storey side and rear extension and replacement of the existing ground floor side window with an enlarged window to house.
